India Dispatches 11 Tonnes of Aid to Flood-Hit Nepal

India has dispatched 11 tonnes of relief supplies to Nepal, which has been affected by floods. The aid includes medicines and other essential relief materials. This effort is part of India's ongoing support for its neighbor during the crisis.
